mae: Quick brainstorm  Need a compact, operational DP plan for an 8-partner micro-beta (6w). Focus: clear gates, minimal ops risk, and measurable success criteria.

dillon: Love that. Keep waves small: 2 waves of 4 with a 10-day stagger. Private evals max 3 concurrent. Reserve 1 spare private slot/week for smoke tests.

tara: Recruitment selector (simple): 50% existing active hosted, 30% platform/on-prem interest, 20% strategic new. Must provide a named integration owner. Also require declared intent: "proof-of-value" vs "pilot-for-prod".

samir: Gates: hard gates = (1) integration kickoff within 10d (owner + first sync), (2) telemetry enabled (x-request-id + sampled traces), (3) perf baseline collected (p50/p95). Soft/score gates = impact, infra effort, timeline urgency.

mae: For perf thresholds propose p95 hosted <= 380ms, p95 private <= 520ms; flag >2x token-cost delta for review. Everyone ok?

dillon: Yes. Also require 12 deterministic prompts per partner for weekly correctness checks. If drift >6% for 2 consecutive weeks, trigger "eval incident" and fallback to stable model.

tara: Legal note: regulated partners need DPA + data flow doc before private runs. We can start hosted work earlier with limited telemetry. Mark intake "legal-block" until cleared.

samir: Incentives: credits + 2 solutions hours per partner; 3 partners get implementation grants (solutions approved). Offer case-study for successful partners.

mae: Stop/pivot criteria: pause invites if >40% of active partners hit blocker-level issues >72h or if private infra utilization >80% for more than 5 days. Also pause if <50% start integrations by day 10.

dillon: Ops asks: tag private runs with wave-id, avoid heavy quantization in week1-2, and don't schedule large streaming workloads in this wave. I'll publish a reservation sheet.

tara: Feedback cadence: weekly 30m sync + two short async surveys (post-integration, mid-program). Capture NPS and 3 concrete asks per partner.

samir: Add a lightweight intake scoring: five fields 0-3 (impact, complexity, infra-risk, timeline, product-fit). Auto-accept >=12, manual review 8-11, decline <8.

oncall-bot: Reminder: reserve emergency hotfix slot set by ops; will post calendar link.

mae: Action items: 1) mae: draft invite copy & exclusions (due EOD) 2) dillon: private slot reservation + wave calendar (due Tue) 3) tara: legal check on regulated candidate + update intake flag (due Wed) 4) samir: baseline harness + deterministic prompts template (due Tue) 5) oncall-bot: attach reservation link when ready.

dillon: small ask  include a brief "de-risk offer" in invite: one guaranteed smoke test within first 14d and 1 triage office-hour. Helps close partners faster.

mae: Great point. I'll add that and keep the invite explicit about time commitment. Closing this thread  will post the one-pager after edits. :rocket:
